title: What are you doing this weekend?
content_html:
goin to local amusement park with my sibling.

continuing to prep for the dog we'll get next week (calling vets, buying items) getting new tires for the car making some investments

will continue to work on little things: read books, study, exercise, practice programming

gotta apply for more jobs, too. i am weighing whether or not i should post on LinkedIn asking for help looking for a new role. my coworkers all follow me on LinkedIn and see my posts and talk to me about them, so they'd surely see this one, but i don't know if that would have a negative effect on my presence at work or not. but i have pretty good reach on LinkedIn and some connections there that could help me find a gig.
